issue_context.title: JVM segfault when importing Arrow data with `month_day_nano_interval` field
comments:
The underlying issue here is the arrow-c-data doesn't actually support exporting `MONTH_DAY_NANO`.

https://github.com/apache/arrow/blob/5a55fb4f66cbd316568085129054b5ff1d2eb089/java/c/src/main/java/org/apache/arrow/c/Format.java#L135-L144

Unfortunately, we assume the get_schema call will always succeed (we don't check the last_error field), and try to load the stream anyway, which fails in the validation step. I'll open a PR to add proper error checking around this call

review_comments: Not sure about this error choice
